title: Claude found mathematical flaws in two cryptographic algorithms that years of expert review missed

content_html:
TL;DR

Claude Mythos found mathematical weaknesses in HAWK (halving key strength) and reduced-round AES (200-800x faster attack). Both discovered mostly autonomously. No production systems affected. Each cost ~$100K.

Anthropic announced on Monday that Claude Mythos Preview has discovered mathematical weaknesses in two cryptographic algorithms. The first substantially weakens HAWK, a post-quantum digital signature scheme under review by NIST, by cutting its effective key strength in half. The second improves the best-known attack on seven-round AES, the most widely used symmetric cipher, by 200-800x. Neither result affects production systems. HAWK is not deployed, and the AES attack targets a reduced variant, not the full cipher.

The distinction from Anthropic’s earlier cybersecurity work is critical. Claude had previously found vulnerabilities in cryptographic libraries, meaning bugs in how programmers implemented algorithms. These new results are flaws in the mathematics of the algorithms themselves, discovered after years of expert human review failed to find them. HAWK survived two rounds of NIST review over two years. Mythos found the weakness in 60 hours of semi-autonomous work, with one researcher providing project management direction rather than technical guidance. The AES result was discovered almost entirely autonomously after Claude initially refused to try, claiming improvement was impossible. A researcher sent three encouraging prompts over three days. Claude produced one billion output tokens and invented a technique it named the “Möbius Bridge.”

Each discovery cost approximately $100,000 in API compute. Anthropic followed responsible disclosure, sharing the HAWK attack with its authors and coordinating with NIST, the US government, and industry partners before publication. The company also partnered with ETH Zurich, Tel Aviv University, and University of Haifa to release CryptanalysisBench, a benchmark for evaluating AI cryptanalytic capabilities. Claude Mythos found 10,000 critical software vulnerabilities in one month, and moving from implementation bugs to algorithmic flaws represents a qualitative leap in what AI can do to security infrastructure.

Anthropic acknowledged follow-up results: a practical attack on 13-round LEA that recovers keys in under an hour on a desktop, and attacks on Serpent-128, Salsa20, Poseidon, and SHA-1. “In just one year, language models have gone from being unable to perform cryptanalysis of even the most basic ciphers to being capable of finding flaws in cryptographic designs that have escaped discovery despite years of human expert review,” the company wrote. The White House launched Gold Eagle to coordinate AI-powered cyber defence, but there is no equivalent programme for cryptographic review. The question Anthropic raised at the end of its post is the one that matters: what happens when a model finds a flaw in a cipher that is already protecting production systems?

content_html_zh:
TL;DR

Claude Mythos 发现了 HAWK（密钥强度减半）和缩减轮次 AES（攻击速度提高 200-800 倍）的数学弱点。 两者大多是自主发现的。 没有生产系统受到影响。 每个成本约 10 万美元。

Anthropic 周一宣布，Claude Mythos Preview 发现了两种加密算法的数学弱点。 第一个方法将 HAWK 的有效密钥强度削减了一半，从而大大削弱了 HAWK（一种正在接受 NIST 审查的后量子数字签名方案）。 第二个将针对七轮 AES（最广泛使用的对称密码）的最著名的攻击提高了 200-800 倍。 这两种结果都不影响生产系统。 未部署 HAWK，并且 AES 攻击的目标是简化变体，而不是完整密码。

与 Anthropic 早期网络安全工作的区别至关重要。 克劳德此前曾发现密码库中的漏洞，这意味着程序员实现算法的方式存在错误。 这些新结果是算法本身的数学缺陷，是经过多年专家人工审查未能发现这些缺陷后发现的。 HAWK 在两年内通过了两轮 NIST 审查。 Mythos 发现了 60 小时半自主工作的弱点，一名研究人员提供项目管理方向而不是技术指导。 克劳德最初拒绝尝试，声称不可能改进，之后几乎完全自主发现了 AES 结果。 一位研究人员在三天内发送了三个令人鼓舞的提示。 克劳德生产了 10 亿个产出代币，并发明了一种名为“莫比乌斯桥”的技术。

每次发现的 API 计算成本约为 100,000 美元。 Anthropic 遵循负责任的披露原则，与作者分享 HAWK 攻击，并在出版前与 NIST、美国政府和行业合作伙伴进行协调。 该公司还与苏黎世联邦理工学院、特拉维夫大学和海法大学合作发布了 CryptanalysisBench，这是评估 AI 密码分析能力的基准。 Claude Mythos 在一个月内发现了 10,000 个关键软件漏洞，从实施错误到算法缺陷代表着人工智能对安全基础设施的作用发生了质的飞跃。

Anthropic 承认了后续结果：对 13 轮 LEA 的实际攻击可在一小时内在桌面上恢复密钥，以及对 Serpent-128、Salsa20、Poseidon 和 SHA-1 的攻击。 该公司写道：“在短短一年内，语言模型已经从无法对最基本的密码进行密码分析，转变为能够发现密码设计中的缺陷，尽管经过多年的人类专家审查，这些缺陷仍未被发现。” 白宫推出了 Gold Eagle 来协调人工智能驱动的网络防御，但没有类似的密码审查计划。 Anthropic 在帖子末尾提出的问题是一个重要的问题：当模型发现已经在保护生产系统的密码中存在缺陷时，会发生什么？
